notes: Stories created for Server-Side Scope Enforcement feature.

change_log.value: Added schema/contract story for scope enforcement

stories.title: Define Tool Scope Enforcement Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define a strict schema for tool scope boundaries including allowed tools, context constraints, and validation rules. Contract must specify how scope is declared and enforced at runtime within tool dispatch.

stories.title: Implement Server-Side Scope Enforcement Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic that validates every tool call against the defined scope contract, ensuring only allowlisted tools and permitted contexts are executed. Reject or block out-of-scope tool calls deterministically.

stories.title: Integrate Scope Enforcement into Tool Router Dispatch
stories.description: Integrate scope validation into the existing tool_router dispatch flow so that every Anthropic tool_use block is checked before execution. Ensure compatibility with existing Pydantic validation and chat history injection.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Scope Enforcement
stories.description: Create tests validating that in-scope tool calls succeed and out-of-scope calls are blocked. Include edge cases for malformed inputs, unauthorized tools, and mixed valid/invalid tool_use sequences.

per_feature.mitigation: Leverage existing allowlist mechanism in tool_router to avoid new architectural complexity
